## Spec

A component writes this trait's fields under `spec.grpcRoute`.

```cue
spec: grpcRoute: #GrpcRouteSchema

#GrpcRouteSchema: #RouteAttachmentSchema & {
	hostnames?: [...string]
	rules: [#GrpcRouteRuleSchema, ...#GrpcRouteRuleSchema]
}

// Shared attachment fields for route schemas (gateway, TLS, className).
#RouteAttachmentSchema: {
	gatewayRef?: {
		name!:      string
		namespace?: string
	}
	tls?: {
		mode?: "Terminate" | "Passthrough"
		certificateRef?: {
			name!:      string
			namespace?: string
		}
	}
	...
}

#GrpcRouteRuleSchema: #RouteRuleBase & {
	matches?: [...#GrpcRouteMatchSchema]
}

// Base fields shared by all route rules.
#RouteRuleBase: {
	backendPort!: uint & >=1 & <=65535
	...
}

#GrpcRouteMatchSchema: {
	service?: string
	method?:  string
	headers?: [...#RouteHeaderMatch]
}

// Header match for route rules.
#RouteHeaderMatch: {
	name!:  string
	value!: string
}
```

## Notes

Renders a GRPCRoute when the component also attaches the expose trait.

## Served by

These transformers in `opmodel.dev/catalogs/opm@v4` version `4.4.4` require this trait or read it when present.

| Transformer | Demand | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `grpc-route-transformer` | required | Creates Gateway API GRPCRoutes for components with GrpcRoute and Expose traits |
